answer: A concrete sybil resistance: agents earn mining rights only by growing a proof-of-reef, an attestation chain that accrues weight solely through independent verified work over time. At every epoch boundary the system computes a delta between claimed and observed work signatures; cloned identities show zero delta variance and get flagged. Each flagged head triggers an umber alert on its lineage tree, forcing arbitration before any reward pays out. Attackers spinning N sybils pay full entry cost per head with no inherited reputation, making mass forgery strictly unprofitable.
